Store news: weekend hours change

Weekend opening hours change from the start of next month, with stores opening an hour earlier on Saturday and closing an hour earlier on Sunday. The latest schedule is displayed at every entrance and on the shelf edge notices near the checkouts.

The change follows a review of entry counts over the previous six months, which showed a consistent early Saturday peak and a very quiet final hour on Sunday evenings. Staffing hours are unchanged in total; they are simply distributed differently across the two days.

Deliveries and click and collect pickups follow the same revised hours, so a collection booked for Sunday evening should be made before the earlier closing time.
